name: What preventative maintenance can extend the life of my wood siding after repair?

mainEntity.name: What preventative maintenance can extend the life of my wood siding after repair?

acceptedAnswer.text: After wood siding repair, consistent preventative maintenance is crucial for extending its lifespan. This includes regular cleaning to remove dirt, mildew, and algae, along with periodic inspections for early signs of wear or damage. Repainting or restaining every 5-7 years, or as recommended by the product manufacturer, is vital for maintaining the protective barrier against moisture and UV rays. Ensuring proper drainage around your home and trimming back vegetation can also prevent moisture accumulation and damage.
acceptedAnswer.description: Preventative maintenance includes regular cleaning, periodic inspections, repainting/restaining every 5-7 years, and ensuring proper drainage around your home.
